title: Plumeform footer (v2)
description: A deep footer panel inset 16px from the window's sides with 32px top corners, lit teal at the top and sinking to green-black. A wordmark and short line at the left, a text link and a paper pill at the right; five columns of small-capital headings over quiet links; a hairline row that opens a wider library of links; and a legal row with copyright, centred links and an email address. Links brighten and underline on hover.
notes: dark by itself (dark class); its gradient runs from the theme's glow colour to the background
